summary: Skier stuck in a drainage at the bottom of Fish Creek Canyon on Buffalo Pass; reporting party had only spotty radio contact and the subject carried no phone, water, food, or skins. Classic Air Medical flew from Glenwood Springs, located the subject from the air but could not land in the terrain and deep snow. RCSAR teams worked up Fish Creek and Buffalo Pass, found the skier uninjured but exhausted on Alpine ski equipment, and brought him to the Fish Creek Falls parking area. First paged 1:30 p.m.; team returned to HQ at 3:00 a.m.
location: Fish Creek Canyon drainage, Buffalo Pass
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Classic Air Medical
